Play branching tic-tac-toe, revisit a position and create another universe. Saved histories are validated and retained on read failure. AI and probability estimates are heuristic.

This page describes the October 2026 source revision. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

## Build from a clean checkout

Node 22.23.4 and npm. Native Android additionally needs JDK 17 and SDK 37; use npm run android with a device/emulator. iOS needs Xcode 26.4+. The Expo 58.0.22 patch passes source, browser and high-severity dependency checks locally; patched native builds are pending at this source freeze. The refinement record separates the prior native baseline from current-patch verification.

```sh
npm ci
npm run check
npm run web
```

These commands build from this source tree. The README also provides a bundled Android development APK path that does not require Metro after installation. Both local variants use the Android Debug key; distribution requires private signing and device acceptance. A successful build is not a store submission.

## Use and verification

Read the [repository README](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-branchxo/blob/main/README.md) for the exact application workflow, privacy/storage behavior and platform differences. The [October refinement record](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-branchxo/blob/main/docs/refinement-2026-10.md) records findings, changes, observed checks, deferred work and the next release action. See the workflow runs for the exact source commit; local verification does not establish a remote CI result.
